_comment: Pinned playbook identity anchors. One write-once doc per `playbook_id` (`spb-<16hex>`), the document `_id`. `anchor_centroid` is the size-weighted, L2-normalised group centroid captured the first time the id was minted during the `name playbooks` pass — it is NEVER updated, so `_assign_playbook_id` matches against a fixed reference rather than a walking latest-centroid. This prevents transitive id chaining (A~B>=thr, B~C>=thr, A~C<thr collapsing under one id). `seed_playbook_id` records the membership hash that minted this anchor (audit trail). Created by `init-indexes --source cowrie`; populated as playbooks are named. Independent of the session_clusters index, so cluster-doc replacement across backward cycles can't move anchors.
